acceptance_signals: Start with no unknowns and a continue-exploration candidate fails before journey creation with a bounded retryable diagnostic.
Update accounts for the answered question, remaining questions, new questions, and inherited candidates; an unusable option fails atomically before human presentation.
A valid exploration choice with a remaining non-material question still succeeds without granting authority.
Tests cover the reproduced failure, corrected retries, update candidate inheritance, valid exploration, and unchanged privacy and human decision boundaries.
Preserve all pre-existing STATUS changes and all excluded changes; update only admitted paths.
Stop if changes require Core semantics, authority changes, installation, external processes, or scope expansion.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-169697804a8b444582674879cb62e11e and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Add bounded MCP Adapter validation for the existing exploration precondition so start and update cannot present continue-exploration with no remaining question. Return private actionable retryable diagnostics, retain Core semantics and human choice, and add regression evidence and closeout documentation.

items: Overbroad validation could reject valid exploratory drafts; validate at the point a decision is presented.
Updates may inherit candidate options; effective remaining questions must be used.
Existing unrelated status evidence must be preserved.
Reviewed assumption: This enforces an existing Core precondition in the MCP Adapter rather than changing the governance contract.
Reviewed assumption: All 133 existing changed paths are classified: STATUS is included and the other 132 paths are excluded.
Reviewed unknown: Installed live Adapter behavior after a source repair remains unverified; installation and live replay are outside this task.

title: Reject unusable exploration options before human selection
